== Reward ==

<ul><li>  {{:Fang of the Wolf}}
</li><li> {{:Patched Gnoll Fur Bundle}}
</li></ul>

== Walkthrough ==

In the Halas bank on the second floor you will find [[Cappi McTarnigal]]. Hail him and he will ask if you are a member of the white rose. When you tell him you are he asks you for mammoth calf hides but at the same time his fellow trainer, [[Ysanna MacGibbon]], mentions gnoll fur. When you ask her what gnoll fur she tells you to take four patches of gnoll fur and sew them together then take four of this product and sew them together and finally take four of that and sew them together. What you end up with is a {{:Patched Gnoll Fur Bundle}}. You can keep it or return it to her for the fang of the wolf.

Tried it with [[Tailoring]] (13) and failed.

Combine 4 [[Patch of Gnoll Fur]] to yield {{:Gnoll Fur Patch}}, then combine four patches to create {{:Gnoll Fur Patch Quarter}}, then combine four quarters to produce {{:Patched Gnoll Fur Bundle }}.

In total you will need 64 Patch of Gnoll Fur to complete this quest, but likely more in the case of combine failures.

== Dialogue ==

;At apprehensive faction

[[Ysanna MacGibbon]] looks your way apprehensively -- she appears to be quite formidable. 

You say, 'Hail, Ysanna MacGibbon' 

You say, 'Hail, Cappi McTarnigal' 

[[Cappi McTarnigal]] says 'Hail there, Kincar! If you are not a [member of the White Rose], then it be best that you stay on the lower level. This here floor is for honest ...ermm respectable rogues only.' 

You say, 'member of the White Rose' 

Cappi McTarnigal says 'I will take these as a donation for I can only reward those who are 'respectable.'' 


;at indifferent (or better) faction

You say, 'Hail, Cappi McTarnigal' 

[[Cappi McTarnigal]] says 'Hail there, Necklace! If you are not a [member of the White Rose], then it be best that you stay on the lower level. This here floor is for honest ...ermm respectable rogues only.' 

You say, 'member of the White Rose' 

Cappi McTarnigal says 'I hope that you are indeed respectable, and loyal to Halas and the Rogues of the White Rose. To do otherwise would bring the wrath of the Six Hammers down on you. But enough with talk! Our caravan to the frigid north leaves in less than two days, and we are short on mammoth calf hides. Return four of them and you will be given items that show your loyalty to our Clan.' 

[[Ysanna MacGibbon]] says 'The mammoth calf hides are used to shield our beasts of burden from the icy wind. You are probably now asking what shields us Northmen from that same icy wind eh? Well, along with many other furs and leathers, we have come to find that [Gnoll Fur] of all things is a good insulator against the cold. Look at their tiny bodies and it's obvious their fur does something good.' 

You say, 'Hail, Ysanna MacGibbon'

You say, 'gnoll fur'

Ysanna MacGibbon says 'You should not be asking where or what a gnoll is, but asking how I make use of that patch fur I find on their corpse. It is quite simple, take four pieces of gnoll fur and sew them together. Take the result and sew four of them together. And again with that product. In the end you will have a bundle of tailored gnoll fur. You can either return it to me or keep it for yourself.' 

''Loot [[Patch of Gnoll Fur]] from various gnolls and craft it (via Tailoring) into different progression pieces, eventually yielding a [[Patched Gnoll Fur Bundle]] (trivial at ~31).

Give Ysanna the [[Patched Gnoll Fur Bundle]]. 

[[Ysanna MacGibbon]] says 'You have done well. Here is a small reward for your effort.' 

<div class="facblock">
* Your faction standing with [[Rogues of the White Rose]] increased by 5. 
{{exp}}
</div>

You receive ~1 platinum, 3 silver from Ysanna MacGibbon. 

Reward is: [[Fang of the Wolf]]
